_meta.source: Competitor prices: aicompanionguides.com/blog/ai-companion-pricing-guide-2026 (Firecrawl, current as of March 2026 per that page). pleasur.ai tiers: pleasur.ai/pricing (live, fetched 2026-06-16). All competitor figures are platform-stated entry/premium monthly prices; treat as dated, not independently re-verified per-vendor this run.

_billing_model_distribution_note: Counted directly from the 16-row master table's Model column (cited draft). Flat (paid tier is the ceiling): Replika, Character.AI, Nomi, Chai, Candy, SpicyChat, Kindroid = 7. Metered (coin/credit/token meter): CrushOn.ai, DreamGF, pleasur.ai = 3. Freemium (model not further specified): Talkie, Anima, Muah, Dream Companion, ChatFAI = 5. Free: Pi AI = 1. Source: aicompanionguides.com Mar 2026 + pleasur.ai/pricing 2026.
_annual_vs_monthly_savings_note: Annual-billing discount off the stated monthly price, percent, computed from competitor_annual_per_month_usd and pleasurai_tier_annual_per_month_usd. Replika 19.99->5.83 (71%), Candy 12.99->5.99 (54%), pleasur.ai Starter 12.99->5.20 (60%), Chai 13.99->11.25 (20%). Dossier cites a typical 40-60% annual lever. Source: aicompanionguides.com Mar 2026 (competitors) + pleasur.ai/pricing 2026 (pleasur.ai).

hidden_cost_ranges._note: Token top-ups $5-20/mo, multi-platform stacking adds ~$20-30/mo extra, conversion fees a few percent; per aicompanionguides.com pricing guide, Mar 2026.
